mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.plate_no AS plateNo, p.park_fee AS parkFee, p.status, p.check_time AS checkTime, p.station_id AS stationId, s.name AS stationName, u.nickname AS checkUserName, p.check_result AS checkResult, p.remark, p.reserve1, p.reserve2, p.creator, p.updater, p.create_time AS createTime, p.update_time AS updateTime FROM pay_check p LEFT JOIN station_info s ON p.station_id = s.id AND s.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN user_info u ON p.check_user_id = u.id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.deleted = 0

SELECT DATE(p.check_time) AS date, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = '已缴清' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS rate FROM pay_check p WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.check_time IS NOT NULL
AND p.check_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{reqVO.startTime})
AND p.check_time < FROM_UNIXTIME(#{reqVO.endTime})
AND p.station_id = #{reqVO.stationId}
GROUP BY DATE(p.check_time) ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = '已缴清' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) FROM pay_check p WHERE p.deleted = 0
AND p.check_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{reqVO.startTime})
AND p.check_time < FROM_UNIXTIME(#{reqVO.endTime})
AND p.station_id = #{reqVO.stationId}

SELECT ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, p.create_time, p.check_time) / 3600.0), 2) FROM pay_check p WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.check_time IS NOT NULL
AND p.create_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{reqVO.startTime})
AND p.create_time < FROM_UNIXTIME(#{reqVO.endTime})
AND p.station_id = #{reqVO.stationId}
